success.description: The48-bit output consists of four whitening bytes and two terminal subkey bytes. Section4.1 initializes A for each terminal guess and models per-wrong-candidate survival by (1-2^-22)^(2^27.5). Counting all2^16 terminal guesses yields E_model W <= 2^48 exp(-2^5.5). The source-rounded2^-17 is not used as an exact bound. The existing2^50 versus2^46 processing-time conflict remains unchanged. Derived first-moment lower bound within the source random-filter model for a unique correct complete stated partial-subkey output. It is not an author-printed aggregate percentage, an experimental rate, or a proved actual-AES success probability; no full master-key recovery is asserted. Correct-tuple retention plus P_model(W>=1)<=E_model W supplies the implication without independence between different wrong tuples or auxiliary trials. The repeated-filter uniformity/independence assumptions are inherited from the source; the source also substitutes mean retained-pair counts for random counts, which is not justified as an actual-cipher upper bound by this audit.
